svg.title: Observed — Recovery by fault level
svg.desc: Higher recovery / positive improvement is better. Comparisons use paired support; percentage points are not percent changes. Point tooltips include exact values, support, source SHA and claim IDs. Nulls are not zero.
svg.text: Higher recovery / positive improvement is better. Comparisons use paired support; percentage points are not percent changes.
All fixed seeds shown. Fixed-three-seed mean is a paired statistic, not an ensemble. Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
Zero references across axes are not independent studies. Identity timing stress is separate in the full report. No real-vehicle safety claim.
Hover a point for exact values and provenance. × below an axis means unavailable; colors match the method legend.
